refNames.1f00ea4e-3c27-4ea5-94c7-7e8d2379ff51: Brink, Saving a moment with its audio

screens.title: Screen map
screens.job: Every Scholē screen, part and component number in one list, by area, with the Mobbin screens each is built after.
screens.note: A working index for building the app, after the Venture Studio's and Mentura's maps; it copies no app.

screens.title: Home
screens.job: Pick up what you were listening to or learning, see your week of study, and start a course when you have none.

parts.name: Continue listening
parts.job: What the person last played, as one large card with Continue, and the rest under way in a row; with nothing under way, find a podcast or audiobook and playlists people made.

parts.name: Continue learning
parts.job: The course you were on, its progress and Resume, which opens the next lesson.

parts.name: Getting started
parts.job: Three steps for a newcomer: choose what to understand, read a first lesson, check it.

parts.name: Your week
parts.job: The days you studied this week. Habits are built by doing (Ethics II.1).

parts.name: Recommended for you
parts.job: Courses from the subjects you picked, each with why.

parts.name: Nature, habits, reason
parts.job: Scholē's three parts, each leading to where it is worked on.

parts.name: New from your shows
parts.job: Episodes out in the last two weeks from shows the person keeps, not yet begun.

screens.title: Get started
screens.job: Three questions, one per screen: what you want to understand, how long a day, where to begin.

parts.name: Subjects you want to understand
parts.job: Tap tiles for the nine subjects, any number.

parts.name: Time a day
parts.job: Ten, twenty or forty minutes.

parts.name: Where to begin
parts.job: The first course of the first subject picked, with Start course.

screens.title: Courses
screens.job: Every course, one per work of Aristotle, filtered by subject and level.

parts.name: Subject tabs
parts.job: All, then the nine subjects.

parts.name: Level filter
parts.job: Start here, Intermediate, Advanced.

parts.name: Course grid
parts.job: Course cards; one in progress shows how far you are.

parts.name: Lecture courses
parts.job: The Yale and MIT lecture courses Scholē already plays, one link away.

screens.title: Subjects
screens.job: The nine subjects in Aristotle's own division: the instrument, knowing, doing and making.

parts.name: Division
parts.job: One group per division, with Aristotle's reason for it.

parts.name: Subject cards
parts.job: Name in English and Greek, what it studies, works and hours.

screens.title: Subject
screens.job: One subject's works as a numbered path in reading order, with examination at the end.

parts.name: Numbered path
parts.job: Each work as a step, with level and hours.

parts.name: Examination at the end
parts.job: Put yourself under examination by people on the subject.

screens.title: Course
screens.job: What the work asks, its books as units with their lessons, and Start or Continue.

parts.name: Course head
parts.job: Title, Greek and Latin names, facts line, Start course or Continue, Save.

parts.name: About this course
parts.job: What the work asks, the caveat when there is one, and the translation read.

parts.name: Units
parts.job: One unit per book, each with its lessons and progress.

parts.name: Progress card
parts.job: How far you are, time left, and Continue learning.

parts.name: Examination card
parts.job: Examiners are people: put yourself under examination on this work.

screens.title: Lesson
screens.job: Read one idea: the passage in Aristotle's words, what it says, its terms, then check it.

parts.name: Passage
parts.job: The text, verbatim, with its Bekker reference and translator.

parts.name: What it says
parts.job: The lesson in plain sentences.

parts.name: Terms
parts.job: Its Greek terms, each opening the glossary.

parts.name: Unit contents
parts.job: The unit's lessons beside the reading, with Start check.

parts.name: Take it to your journal
parts.job: A question that opens a new journal entry with it.

parts.name: Previous and next
parts.job: The lessons either side, across units.

screens.title: Lesson check
screens.job: Two or three tap-choice questions, one at a time, each answered with why. No score.

parts.name: Progress bar
parts.job: How many questions are left; the cross goes back to the lesson.

parts.name: Question
parts.job: The question and its choices, numbered for the keyboard.

parts.name: Answer bar
parts.job: Right, or not quite, with why, the passage again, and Continue.

screens.title: Lesson complete
screens.job: What you now know, your week, the journal question, and the next lesson.

parts.name: What you now know
parts.job: The lesson's terms and its one idea.

parts.name: Next lesson
parts.job: Continue goes straight to it; at a unit's end, the course page.

parts.name: Share lesson
parts.job: Copy the lesson's link for a friend.

screens.title: Your growth
screens.job: Nature, habits and reason: what you are drawn to, how steadily you study, and how far you know each subject.

parts.name: Reason graph
parts.job: One axis per subject: the share of its lessons you have read and checked.

parts.name: Habits
parts.job: Days studied in the last four weeks.

parts.name: Nature
parts.job: The subjects you said you want to understand, and Change.

screens.title: Saved
screens.job: Lessons and courses you saved to come back to.

screens.title: Search
screens.job: Find a course, a lesson or a term by any word in it.

screens.title: Glossary
screens.job: Every Greek term the courses teach, with where each is taught.

screens.title: Put yourself under examination
screens.job: Say what you will answer for on a course; people examine you in person. No grade.

screens.title: Your library
screens.job: Your shelves by the ways of learning, books by Thema section within them, and your claims.

parts.name: Shelves
parts.job: One shelf per way of learning, each with its count and covers.

parts.name: Books by section
parts.job: Within a shelf, books grouped by Thema section.

parts.name: Your claims
parts.job: What you have argued, each opening its claim.

screens.title: Browse
screens.job: Books not on your shelves yet: lists for you, this week's reads, a Thema section best rated first, or a search of the open library.

parts.name: Search the open library
parts.job: Title, author or subject.

parts.name: Lists for you
parts.job: Rows of covers from lists that fit what you keep.

parts.name: Sections
parts.job: A Thema section or category, best rated first.

screens.title: Podcast
screens.job: A podcast's own page, to explore before following it: its episodes, each heard here straight away.

parts.name: Show head
parts.job: Artwork, title, publisher and Follow.

parts.name: About
parts.job: What the show is, in two lines.

parts.name: Episodes
parts.job: Newest first, each with its date, length and Play.

screens.title: Episode
screens.job: An episode of a show not yet on your shelves, heard here; keeping the show keeps your place.

parts.name: Episode head
parts.job: Title, show, date, length and Play as the largest control.

parts.name: Notes
parts.job: The show's notes for the episode.

parts.name: Keep the show
parts.job: Following keeps your place in this episode.

screens.title: Episode you keep
screens.job: One episode of a show you keep, heard from the show's own feed, with its transcript when it has one.

parts.name: Player
parts.job: Play, skip, speed and your place, kept.

parts.name: Transcript
parts.job: The words as they are said, each line opening that moment.

parts.name: Notes at a moment
parts.job: What you wrote at a time in the episode.

screens.title: New from your shows
screens.job: Every episode of the shows you keep out in the last two weeks and not begun, newest first.

screens.title: Search your episodes
screens.job: A word or phrase looked for in every episode transcript you keep, each place opening the episode at that moment.

screens.title: Audiobook
screens.job: A LibriVox audiobook heard here as an episode is: cover, Play or Continue as the largest control, then its chapters.

parts.name: Hero
parts.job: Cover, title, author, and Play or Continue naming the chapter.

parts.name: Metadata
parts.job: One line of facts, topics, and two lines about the recording.

parts.name: Chapters
parts.job: Every chapter, with where you are.

parts.name: More
parts.job: More by the author and on its first topic.

screens.title: People you follow
screens.job: The hosts and guests you follow, and the newest episodes that name them, each played here.

screens.title: Person
screens.job: A person's own profile: who they are, their accounts, the podcasts they host and their guest appearances on any show.

parts.name: Name and Follow
parts.job: The name, with Follow at the top right.

parts.name: Who they are
parts.job: Two lines from Wikipedia and their accounts as icons.

parts.name: Shows they host
parts.job: Their podcasts and the newest episodes.

parts.name: Guest appearances
parts.job: Episodes on any show that name them, each heard here.

screens.title: Topic
screens.job: One topic: a place, period or school grouped by form, or a listening subject with its top podcasts and most heard audiobooks side by side.

screens.title: Playlists
screens.job: Every playlist chosen by people, those serving what you are working toward first, each saying why.

screens.title: Playlist
screens.job: A playlist chosen by a person: who chose it and why, its things in order, and one button that starts the first you have not begun.
screens.note: Spotify's playlist page is the last screen of the referenced flow; Scholē's playlist says who chose it and why.

screens.title: Made for you
screens.job: A playlist Scholē made for you, marked as made and from what, with Play, Save, Another and Change it.

screens.title: Guest (old link)
screens.job: Redirects to the person's page; guest pages became people's pages.
screens.note: A redirect with no layout of its own; it has nothing to build after.

screens.title: Collections (old link)
screens.job: Redirects to Playlists; collections are called playlists now.
screens.note: A redirect with no layout of its own.

screens.title: Collection (old link)
screens.job: Redirects to the playlist of the same id.
screens.note: A redirect with no layout of its own.

screens.title: Snips
screens.job: Moments you saved from episodes and audiobooks, each with its clip, transcript lines and note, played again from the moment.
screens.note: After Snipd's snips; Snipd is not on Mobbin, so the refs are the nearest saved-audio-moment flows found.

parts.name: Snip
parts.job: The clip, its show and time, the lines said, and your note.

parts.name: Play from here
parts.job: Opens the episode at the moment.

parts.name: By show
parts.job: Snips grouped by episode, newest first.

screens.title: Up next
screens.job: The listening queue: what plays now and what plays next, reordered by drag, with Clear.
screens.note: Pocket Casts is not on Mobbin; Spotify's queue is the reference.

parts.name: Now playing
parts.job: The episode or chapter playing, with its place.

parts.name: Next
parts.job: The queue in order, each with a handle and remove.

parts.name: Add to Up next
parts.job: From any episode row: Play next or Play last.

screens.title: Instrument course
screens.job: Learn an instrument: the piece to practise today with its recording and score, Log practice, and every piece in order.

parts.name: Today's piece
parts.job: Listen first, the score on IMSLP, and Log practice.

parts.name: Practice minutes
parts.job: The last two weeks of minutes.

parts.name: Pieces
parts.job: Every piece in order, to hear, read and mark learned.

screens.title: Course on argument
screens.job: The modern work behind dialectic practice, unit by unit, then the people it reads, each opening their page.

screens.title: Debate course
screens.job: A course on the quarrels new art and inventions start: each unit a playlist with the question argued in it.

screens.title: Course on dialectic
screens.job: Scholē's course on dialectic, where its practice lives, laid out as the unit courses are.

screens.title: Lecture
screens.job: A lecture of a course not yet on your shelves, watched here with its transcript; starting the course keeps your place.

screens.title: Course made in chat
screens.job: A course drafted in chat: its name and goal, Start, then each unit with the works and passages it reads, each cited.

screens.title: Why I am learning this
screens.job: Before a course: what moves you to learn it, marked with the seven origins, and for the sake of what; kept in your journal.

screens.title: Learn item
screens.job: One thing you are learning: its status and dates, what it taught you, and what its way asks for, with the recording or transcript here.

screens.title: Lecture you keep
screens.job: One lecture of a kept course: it plays from its publisher, the transcript beneath, and finishing it opens the next.

parts.name: Player
parts.job: The lecture from its publisher, your place kept.

parts.name: Transcript
parts.job: Beneath the player, searchable.

parts.name: Course contents
parts.job: The lectures in order, with Next.

screens.title: Your examination
screens.job: Your examination: the link to invite examiners and the record of attestations as it stands.
screens.note: Examination by people has no counterpart in the listed apps: Uxcel, Brilliant and Coursera grade by machine, which Scholē refuses.

screens.title: Examine someone
screens.job: Asked to examine someone: what they answer for, joining with your name, and your attestation in your own words, written once.
screens.note: No listed app asks one learner to attest to another in their own words.

screens.title: Great Ideas
screens.job: The Great Ideas Scholē has passages for, the most discussed first.

screens.title: Idea
screens.job: One Great Idea: where it is listed, how many works discuss it, where to start, its passages by era and the terms that grew from it.

screens.title: Term
screens.job: A term under a Great Idea, with journal prompts: your own case first, then stories and real cases, then an essay.

screens.title: People in history
screens.job: Everyone in history with a page in Scholē, by era, each era opening its topic.

screens.title: Philosophers (old link)
screens.job: Redirects to People in history.
screens.note: A permanent redirect with no layout of its own.

screens.title: Philosopher (old link)
screens.job: Redirects to the person's page and tab.
screens.note: A permanent redirect with no layout of its own.

screens.title: Annotate
screens.job: The annotation game: choose a dialogue; the one filled button starts the one you have done least.

screens.title: Annotate a dialogue
screens.job: Five rounds on one dialogue, each a passage to annotate, in an order fixed by the seed so a reload keeps it.

parts.name: Round progress
parts.job: Five rounds; the cross leaves.

parts.name: Passage
parts.job: The passage to annotate.

parts.name: Answer
parts.job: What each answer means, and agreement so far.

screens.title: Practice guidelines
screens.job: What each annotation answer means, with examples from Euthyphro, the kinds of argument and their critical questions.
screens.note: A reference page of rules and examples; none of the listed apps has one worth copying.

screens.title: Doing
screens.job: The Doing door: practical wisdom, leading to Qualities, Dialectic and Ideas.
screens.note: Dead: the new home no longer links it, and nothing else does.

screens.title: Knowing
screens.job: The Knowing door: science and wisdom for its own sake.
screens.note: Dead: the new home no longer links it, and nothing else does.

screens.title: Article
screens.job: A Wikipedia article read inside Scholē as plain text, credited under its licence with a link to the original.

screens.title: Book
screens.job: One book's page: cover, what it is about, ratings, a free read or listen when in the public domain, contents, editions, books like it, and where you are with it.

parts.name: Book head
parts.job: Cover, title, author, ratings, and the shelf it is on.

parts.name: Read or listen free
parts.job: The whole book from the Internet Archive, Gutenberg, Standard Ebooks or LibriVox, or a preview.

parts.name: About and contents
parts.job: What it is about, its contents and editions.

parts.name: Where it sits
parts.job: Its Thema section, books like it, more by its author.

parts.name: Claims and ideas
parts.job: The claims that cite it and the ideas that came from it.

screens.title: Reading
screens.job: A public-domain book read one chapter at a time in your font, size and page colour; a selected passage can be highlighted, quoted or kept as a claim.
screens.note: Reading in the app is not a primary focus of Scholē; this reader serves reference.

screens.title: Author
screens.job: One author: photo, life dates and biography, how many of their books can be read or heard free here, and their books best rated first.

screens.title: Lists
screens.job: Lists of books and other things, each shown by its first covers.

screens.title: List
screens.job: One list in its order: each book numbered, where you are with it, how many you have read, and Read in this order.

screens.title: List of things
screens.job: A list beyond books, in its order: Keep the ones not kept, each row opening its thing.

screens.title: Your reading
screens.job: What you are reading now, a goal for the year if you set one, the days you read, Want to read in your order, and the books you finished by year.

screens.title: Highlights
screens.job: Every highlight you keep, grouped by book and in reading order, searchable and narrowed by colour; exported or sent to the journal.
screens.note: Kindle's notes and highlights are not on Mobbin; Blinkist and Fable are the nearest found.

screens.title: Notes
screens.job: Your journal works filed under learning, newest first, each with what it is about; each opens in the journal.

screens.title: Passages (old link)
screens.job: Redirects to Highlights' search inside your books.
screens.note: A redirect with no layout of its own.

screens.title: Summary
screens.job: A book's summary, about fifteen minutes to read, written once by a model from the book's Wikipedia article and labelled so.

screens.title: Find
screens.job: Something from Browse with no page of its own yet (a film, an album, a work of art): a watch page for video, else what it is with its verb and Save.

screens.title: Dialectic
screens.job: Dialectic to watch and listen to: one recording first, new debates from the channels, the questions, and old and new arguments in turn.

parts.name: This week's recording
parts.job: One recording with the page's one filled button; changes each Monday.

parts.name: New debates
parts.job: From the channels' feeds, video and podcast told apart.

parts.name: Questions
parts.job: Each showing what it holds.

screens.title: Debate
screens.job: A debate: what is argued, from which work, by whom, when and in what format; Listen while live, Start for its host, else Remind me.

screens.title: Host a debate
screens.job: Hosting a debate: the motion, the work it comes from, the format, the time, and whether the host takes a side.

screens.title: Room
screens.job: A live room: speakers as large faces, the question on the table, listeners small, raised hands, chat, and Leave quietly or Ask to speak.

parts.name: Speakers
parts.job: Large faces, the host first.

parts.name: On the table
parts.job: The question being argued.

parts.name: Listeners
parts.job: Small faces.

parts.name: Hands raised
parts.job: The host's queue.

parts.name: Foot bar
parts.job: Leave quietly and Ask to speak.

screens.title: Open a room
screens.job: Opening a live table on one work or one question; the person who opens it hosts it.

screens.title: Thread
screens.job: A question answered in writing, with replies to replies.

screens.title: Ask a question
screens.job: Asking a question for people to answer in writing, on a work or on its own.

screens.title: Post
screens.job: A post on its own page: what it answers, the post, Debate this, the reply box and every reply indented beneath.

screens.title: Person in Dialectic
screens.job: A person in Dialectic: face, name, Follow, their points, and their posts and reposts.

screens.title: Questions
screens.job: Every standing question Dialectic is arranged by, those drawing on works you keep first.
screens.note: Kialo-like apps are not on Mobbin; Goodreads' list of discussion topics is the nearest.

screens.title: Question
screens.job: A standing question: what it asks, the recordings that argue it, and the positions taken on it across the ages, each with its place in the work.
screens.note: Positions across the ages, each cited to its place, is an argument map; Kialo is not on Mobbin and Reddit and Discord have no equivalent.

screens.title: Discussion on a topic
screens.job: A topic's discussion, where a term or a person can be the topic: the question and its positions when curated, then the discussion.

screens.title: Qualities
screens.job: The qualities you are building, each with who you saw it in and how much you wrote about it; then those named by authors you finished, to add.
screens.note: No listed app tracks virtues of character; habit trackers count, which this page does not.

screens.title: Quality
screens.job: A quality: what it is and the one act, writing about it; who you saw it in in your own words; what teaches it; and what you wrote.
screens.note: No listed app tracks virtues of character.

screens.title: Claim
screens.job: One claim: what you said about it over time, each saying quoted with where and when, and who else says it. What was said, never what is believed.
screens.note: A personal record of sayings over time has no counterpart in the listed apps.

screens.title: Schedule
screens.job: The next four weeks of your calendar filtered to Scholē (reading groups, salons, examinations, lectures), by day, with + to add.
